description: This file declares the PackageManagerImplementation class, which implements package downloading, installation, and handling functionalities within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes class definitions, method signatures, and internal data structures related to package management, telemetry, and configuration.

classes.name: PackageManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements package download, installation, and management functionalities, including telemetry and configuration handling within the plugin namespace.

classes.name: State
classes.description: Represents the state of a package, including installation status, lock count, runtime configuration, and metadata paths.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: JSON container class for package manager configuration, primarily managing the download directory.

classes.name: DownloadInfo
classes.description: Stores information about a download task, including URL, ID, retries, rate limit, and cancellation status.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Initiates a package download with specified options.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Pauses an ongoing download.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes a paused download.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing download.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a downloaded package file.

methods.name: Progress
methods.description: Reports progress of a download.

methods.name: GetStorageDetails
methods.description: Retrieves storage quota and usage details.

methods.name: RateLimit
methods.description: Sets rate limit for a download.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for download events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a download notification callback.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the package manager with the service context.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the package manager.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Installs a package with specified ID, version, and metadata.

methods.name: Uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls a package by ID.

methods.name: ListPackages
methods.description: Lists all installed packages.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Configures package metadata.

methods.name: PackageState
methods.description: Retrieves the installation state of a package.

methods.name: GetConfigForPackage
methods.description: Gets runtime configuration for a package.

methods.name: Register (installer)
methods.description: Registers a callback for installer events.

methods.name: Unregister (installer)
methods.description: Unregisters an installer callback.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks a package for exclusive access.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks a previously locked package.

methods.name: GetLockedInfo
methods.description: Retrieves info about a locked package.

methods.name: getRuntimeConfig
methods.description: Static method to convert package config metadata to runtime config.

methods.name: recordAndPublishTelemetryData
methods.description: Records and publishes telemetry data related to package operations.

methods.name: getCurrentTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp for telemetry.
